🇺🇸🇷🇺🇨🇳🚨‼️ UNEXPECTED: TRUMP-PUTIN MEETING?

Ushakov, Putin’s foreign policy aide, says Trump and Putin might meet in China in November.

A three-party meeting hosted by Xi Jinping was discussed, but they may meet separately.

So maybe Putin and Trump meet in 2026. Interesting. ht
